description: Agent Tax Records: submit a sales tax record with the sales tax remittances it answers to: the record with its reference, the taxing jurisdiction, the rate it states as a percent, its currency and each filing period with its id, the period, the taxable sales, the sales tax collected and the remittance due date; each remittance with its id, reference, the period it remits, the day remitted and the amount. The signed report gives the record and the remittances, the collection rate in each period against the stated rate, each period with sales against the remittances made for it, and the sales tax collected in each period against the sales tax remitted for the same period, and counts them, and names a divergent sales tax record: sales tax remitted for a period short of the sales tax collected for it, a collection rate that drifts more than 0.05 of a percentage point from the stated rate, and a period with sales and no remittance at all; then a period remitted above its collections, a remittance naming a period the record does not hold and a remittance dated after its period’s due date, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No filing periods, no remittances, no stated rate, a period with no taxable sales or tax collected, or a remittance with no amount leaves those points unverified. Periods match without case, punctuation or word order with quarters and month names folded, the remittances for one period add together, amounts compare to the cent and dates by the day. This reads whether the sales tax collected is the sales tax remitted, period by period. Verdict tax_sales_tax_divergent, tax_sales_tax_partial, tax_sales_tax_unverified or tax_sales_tax_consistent. POST /api/tax-sales-tax-check. Reads the tax records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it gives no tax advice, prepares or files nothing and decides nothing about anyone’s tax liability, which stay with the taxpayer and their tax professional, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Tax Records reads tax records: a filed return, tax payment records, sales tax records, withholding records, information returns, estimated payment records, deduction claims and tax authority notices, each against the books, schedules and deadline, the amounts the filed returns state as due, the stated rate and the sales tax remittances, the payroll record and the withholding remittances, the payment records, the periods and amounts the stated method sets, the support records, or the filed returns and responses it answers to. The family’s ground is the tax record set itself; the Agent Bookkeeping family reads the books the filings are drawn from, and this family reads the filings, payments and notices after they exist. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-tax-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-tax-records/.
